{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-14tzgyz",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop at P-R (n-ax2alr) is the specific disturbance that triggered AL-44. The point register maps this alarm to receiving-header pressure but does not guarantee every supply disturbance appears in the sample export; however, since n-ax2alr confirms a recorded drop below thresholds and n-14tzgyz states the mapping limitation, the link represents the causal chain where the specific event (drop) caused the indication mapped by the register.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure had not dropped below 4.5 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered.",
      "competingExplanation": "The alarm could be a false positive due to sensor drift or wiring fault; however, n-gybvj2 and n-ily57r support that P-R dropping triggers the alarm, making this the primary supported explanation for now.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether other disturbances occurred simultaneously but were not sampled."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-q7dwrs",
      "toKey": "n-1rpd0or",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The blank field for the temporary instruction attachment (n-q7dwrs) indicates no documented authorization or change record was attached at issue time. This directly supports that no line opening was authorized, as per n-1rpd0or.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a temporary instruction had been attached and authorized, the line opening might have been permitted.",
      "competingExplanation": "An undocumented verbal authorization could exist; however, n-uk8heo supports that no such attachment existed at issue time, making this link supported under current evidence.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record of any verbal or informal communication regarding line openings."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-gw70kw",
      "toKey": "n-14tzgyz",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' without identifying valve states (n-gw70kw). This lack of detail supports the limitation that the point register does not prove every disturbance appears in exports, as n-14tzgyz notes.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the shift log had identified valve states, it might have clarified whether a specific disturbance was expected or unrecorded.",
      "competingExplanation": "The lack of detail in logs could be due to oversight rather than system limitations; however, n-14tzgyz explicitly notes this limitation as supported by evidence.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record of valve states during the incident window."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The analysis identifies three causal links: (1) pressure drop at P-R caused AL-44 alarm, (2) blank temporary instruction attachment supported lack of authorized line opening, and (3) incomplete shift log details reinforced the limitation that point register exports do not capture all disturbances. Competing explanations for false alarms or undocumented verbal authorizations remain unresolved due to evidence gaps.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Whether a service-routing change occurred between 2024-03-01 and May 20, 2024", "If verbal authorization existed for line openings", "Exact valve states during the incident window"],
    "alternatives": [
      "False alarm due to sensor drift or wiring fault (unsupported but possible)",
      "Undocumented verbal communication regarding air supply changes"
    ],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },
  "evidenceRequests": []
}
